notes: User authorized one weapon and one armor slot per Unit, separate from profession Tools, and sensible provisional stats. Ordinary weapons deal 24 damage per visual round; the recovered Asgard rifle deals 30, compared with the existing unequipped baseline of 18. Armor absorbs 2 damage per incoming hit, with at least 1 damage getting through. No new physical armor is granted. Gear and stats are snapshotted on deployment so later base changes do not rewrite combat history.
